Separate coffee and tea requirements Identify whether the pack will hold coffee beans, ground coffee, loose-leaf tea or sachets. Check usable volume with that product. Review valve requirements for roasted coffee separately from tea storage, and choose the structure around the required protection and storage conditions. Plan the panels and filled base Review front, back, side panels and the flat base as separate artwork areas. Request the final dieline before placing copy across folds. Check the top opening and filled base dimensions against the filling and shelf requirements. Review zipper access and final sealing Confirm zipper location, usable opening and the final top-seal allowance. Check filling access, opening and reclosing with the actual contents.
